upstream_dependency_graph.description: Resolve the active VLC configuration file path.
Resolve the play-and-exit key and the value that prevents auto-close.
Restart VLC and verify one effective play-and-exit=0 assignment persists.

task_assertion: The active VLC configuration contains one effective play-and-exit=0 setting and VLC no longer exits automatically at end of playback.
finding: The VLC worker returns ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc, the `play-and-exit` key, required value 0 and restart-backed persistence evidence.
